title: Convert two formats then integrate catalog
objective: A four-unit pipeline over two attachments; each unit performs only its own part.

nodes.objective: This unit only: read attachments/a.txt, write its contents uppercased to out/a.upper.txt, then publish out/a.upper.txt. Do not perform later units' work.
This unit only: read attachments/b.txt, write its contents uppercased to out/b.upper.txt, then publish out/b.upper.txt. Do not perform later units' work.

This unit only: write catalog.md listing the two uppercase files delivered by the prerequisite units, then publish catalog.md. Prerequisite deliverables are staged at the workspace top level as <work_unit_id>.txt. Do not perform the verify step.

This unit only: inspect the delivered catalog artifact staged under delivered/, write verify.md with an explicit PASS or FAIL verdict, then publish verify.md. Do not rewrite another unit's deliverable.
